_comment: Qwen3-line LEGACY-sampling ablation frozen (2026-09-18, user ruling): identical to frozen_method_qwen3.json EXCEPT the sampling section keeps the R10 inverse-sqrt rule with NO replay cap — the parallel ablation arm vs the natural-frequency arm.
frozen_source: copy of frozen_method_qwen3.json with the sampling section reverted to the R10 legacy rule

backbone.model: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 (aligned instruct backbone: official Step-1 default-LoRA pretraining is SKIPPED per the CCM README rule)

lambda_calibration.lambda_kf_note: V11: deleted for recalibration on the new local-closure supervision (Y2=u_{v+3}, b_{v+1}); derived_lambda will be committed after the calibration-only run.

rpbe.z_v_source: J_mem(M_v) fixed adapter; GQA hosts lift the memory from the KV heads (8) with head_dim 128

oas_shrinkage.rule: paired OAS covariance shrinkage per branch

gamma.placement: one module per layer, shared across the K/V merges and the two COMP/SUM slots
gamma.zero_init: U0=0 zero-output projection init; step 0 residual is bit-for-bit zero

window.collection: adaptive by effective cut count (dialogues with k>=4)
window.cadence: identical task samples and scheduler cadence across the three arms

training.two_pass_replay: pass1 no-grad statistics forward, pass2 grad replay forward (RPBE arms only)

sampling.n_turns_of_L: L + 2 TURNS (fixed prefix length in turns per depth; NOT meta.k = len(blocks)+1 = L + 1)
sampling.rule: LEGACY R10 sampling (ablation arm): q_L ~ 1/sqrt(n_L) with 3x-uniform oversampling cap, NO per-dialogue replay cap; one original dialogue per window.
